_note: Time-limited npm audit exceptions (security baseline CHG-001). Each needs owner approval. An entry stops counting once it expires or once the package publishes a version newer than max_version, so a fix forces a re-check.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS in extglob matching. No patched release exists. Reached only through @tailwindcss/cli -> @parcel/watcher at build time (watch mode, which the build does not use), with our own glob patterns. Nothing from npm is deployed to the server.
